description: ISTEM is a high-energy crew of developers, builders, and problem-solvers driven by a shared mission: turning complex technical challenges into seamless, scalable solutions. Combining expertise in full-stack architecture, machine learning, and rapid prototyping, we build sharp, efficient tech that solves real-world problems under pressure.
summary:
Constellation is an interactive web app for the NASA Space Apps Challenge that makes hypotheses about the outer solar system and infrared astronomy accessible to everyone.

The platform is centered on two main topics: the scientific search for Planet X and NASA’s SPHEREx mission. Users can search for objects in the sky, such as Jupiter, and compare multi-spectral near-infrared images taken on different dates, using the interactive comparison explorer. There is also a built-in glossary that defines technical terms such as Right Ascension and Declination. To make the science even more fun, the site also has SPHEREx Sky Run, a mini game where players collect scan fragments across alien worlds. Constellation uses real NASA survey data, interactive visuals and gamified learning to let anyone follow their curiosity and explore the universe"
details:
What is it and how does it work?

Constellation is an interactive web platform that simplifies tracking changes in space objects using NASA SPHEREx infrared data. Users can search categories like planets, asteroids, comets, stars, and Messier objects, retrieve multi date observations, and compare images side-by-side or toggle timestamps to spot shifts in position, brightness, and structure. It also features a built-in terminology guide and an interactive mini-game, SPHEREx Sky Run.

What are the advantages?

  • Accessibility: Converts complex astronomical datasets into a clean, browser-based interface.
  • Educational Value: Enables students and enthusiasts to observe real cosmic changes without specialized software.
  • Clarity: Provides direct side by side image comparisons with simple interpretation guides.

What is the expected impact?

Democratizing space science data by making satellite observations engaging and accessible, inspiring curiosity about the universe and active missions like SPHEREx.

What tools, languages, hardware, and software were used?

  • Editor: Visual Studio Code (VS Code)
  • Platform: Base44 for rapid prototyping and deployment
  • Data Sources: NASA SPHEREx mission and infrared survey datasets

How is the project creative?

It transforms a dry astronomical database into an intuitive "search, select, and compare" dashboard, blending real scientific visualization with an embedded mini game to bridge serious research with interactive learning.

What factors did the team take into account?

  • User Experience (UX): Integrated simple definitions and help features to prevent jargon overload.
  • Data Readability: Ensured users can easily interpret infrared imagery, coordinate shifts, and color variations.
  • Engagement: Balanced scientific accuracy with interactive elements to sustain user curiosity.
